name: HubSpot
oneLiner: New HubSpot OAuth apps must now be built as CLI 'projects' (legacy public apps can't be created since 2026-06-23); setup is about an hour with no review, but an unlisted marketplace-distribution app is capped at 25 installs until a Marketplace listing (3+ active installs, ~10 business days initial review) is approved.

verdict.activeEffort: 45–90 min to create, upload and test the app; 1–2 days for Marketplace listing prep
verdict.approvalWait: None for up to 25 installs; Marketplace listing: initial review within 10 business days, full process up to ~60 days after feedback (HubSpot's stated targets)
verdict.timeToFirstConnection: Same day — install into a developer test account or your own standard account
verdict.timeToProduction: Same day for up to 25 customer accounts (with an 'unverified app' warning); unlimited installs only after Marketplace listing approval, typically weeks
verdict.reviewTrigger: Exceeding 25 installs of a marketplace-distribution OAuth app (or removing the unverified-app warning) requires an approved App Marketplace listing
verdict.cost: Free (developer account, test accounts and listing are free)

fastPath: Use Composio's managed HubSpot OAuth app today — Composio lists HubSpot (HUBSPOT) under 'Composio-managed OAuth available' (confirm via the toolkit's composio_managed_auth_schemes). Meanwhile build your own project-based app with distribution=marketplace and auth=oauth; it works immediately for developer test accounts and up to 25 real customer accounts while you collect the 3 active installs needed to apply for listing.

steps.title: Get a HubSpot developer account and sign in
steps.detail: Sign up at https://developers.hubspot.com (free developer account) or use an account with developer project access. A human must create the account and verify email.

steps.title: Install and authenticate the HubSpot CLI
steps.detail: npm install -g @hubspot/cli@latest (docs reference v7.6.0+), then run hs account auth. This opens HubSpot in a browser to generate/paste a personal access key — the human completes the browser step; the agent can run everything else.

phases.title: Create and upload the app project

steps.title: Scaffold an app project
steps.detail: hs project create → base content 'App' → distribution 'Marketplace' (needed for >10 external installs) → authentication 'OAuth' → pick features. Legacy public apps (Developer account → Apps → Create app UI) can no longer be created since 2026-06-23.

steps.title: Configure auth in app-hsmeta.json
steps.detail: Set uid (keep stable forever), name, and auth: { type: 'oauth', distribution: 'marketplace', redirectUrls: ['https://your-callback'] (HTTPS; http://localhost only for testing; no IP addresses), requiredScopes: [...], optionalScopes: [...], conditionallyRequiredScopes: [...] }. Include a read scope for every CRM object you touch.

steps.title: Upload and copy client credentials
steps.detail: hs project upload, then hs project open → Project Components → your app → Auth tab → Client credentials: copy Client ID and Client secret into your OAuth server config.

steps.title: Create a developer test account
steps.detail: HubSpot → Development → Test accounts → Create developer test account. Test accounts do not count toward install caps; they expire after 90 days without API calls unless renewed.

steps.title: Install and run the OAuth flow
steps.detail: Projects → your project → app UID → Distribution tab → Add test install(s) → Install → tick the unverified-app box → Connect app. Or drive it yourself: https://app.hubspot.com/oauth/authorize?client_id=...&redirect_uri=...&scope=<required, %20-separated>&optional_scope=...&state=..., then POST https://api.hubapi.com/oauth/v3/token with grant_type=authorization_code. Access tokens last 1800 s; refresh with grant_type=refresh_token.

steps.title: Sign the Acceptable Use Policy for non-test installs
steps.detail: For marketplace-distribution apps, installs into accounts other than developer test accounts are blocked until the AUP is signed (Distribution tab). This is a legal acceptance a human must make.

phases.title: App Marketplace listing (to lift the 25-install cap)
phases.duration: ~10 business days to first feedback; up to ~60 days total (waiting on HubSpot)

steps.title: Reach 3 active, unaffiliated installs
steps.detail: At least three unique production HubSpot accounts not affiliated with your organization, each with successful app activity in the past 30 days.

steps.title: Prepare and submit the listing
steps.detail: Provide live, public URLs for Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, support contact and HubSpot-specific setup documentation; pricing matching your website; remove any unused scopes (every requested scope must be used). Submit from the app's listing section.

steps.title: Respond to Ecosystem Quality review
steps.detail: Initial review within 10 business days; the feedback loop should complete within 60 days of feedback being shared. On approval the 25-install cap and the unverified warning are removed.

requirements.detail: Project-based apps are created and uploaded with @hubspot/cli (hs project create / upload); the old UI path for new public apps is gone.

requirements.item: HTTPS redirect URL on a domain
requirements.detail: redirectUrls must be HTTPS; http://localhost allowed only for testing; IP addresses unsupported; the token request redirect_uri must match.
Required before marketplace-distribution apps can be installed outside developer test accounts.

requirements.item: Installer is Super Admin or has Marketplace Access permission
requirements.detail: End users without this permission cannot complete the install in their portal.
Access tokens expire after 30 minutes (expires_in 1800); your backend must refresh via /oauth/v3/token.
3+ active unaffiliated installs, live ToS/privacy/support/setup-doc URLs, matching pricing, only used scopes.

scopes.purpose: Basic OAuth scope historically required for public apps
Read contacts; note tokens grant access per scope, not limited to the installing user's own record permissions
Read deals; consider optionalScopes for features tied to paid hubs so installs on lower tiers don't fail
Service Hub tickets; typical candidate for optionalScopes because not every portal has access

technical.pkce: unknown (not mentioned in HubSpot OAuth docs; one community report of a 'PKCE required' error)
technical.refreshTokens: Access tokens expire after 30 minutes (expires_in 1800). A refresh_token is returned with the code exchange; POST grant_type=refresh_token with client_id, client_secret, redirect_uri and refresh_token to /oauth/v3/token.
technical.redirectUriRules: Registered in app-hsmeta.json auth.redirectUrls (at least one); HTTPS required, http://localhost allowed for testing only, IP addresses not supported; must exactly match the redirect_uri used in the authorize and token requests.
gotchas: Every requiredScopes entry must be in the authorize URL's scope param, or the consent page errors; put tier-dependent scopes in optional_scope.
If a portal lacks a product for a required scope, the install fails for that customer.
Changing the app uid in app-hsmeta.json makes HubSpot treat it as a brand-new app.
Migrating a legacy public app with >25 installs to the new platform automatically enforces the 25-install cap until listed.
Install errors are visible under Development → Monitoring → Logs → OAuth (AUTHORIZATION_REQUEST, AUTHORIZATION_CODE_EXPIRY).
Unlisted apps show an 'unverified app' banner; users must type 'I accept the risk' to proceed.

blockers.symptom: New customer installs fail once 25 non-test accounts have installed the app
blockers.resolution: Submit for App Marketplace listing early (needs 3 active unaffiliated installs); cap lifts on approval. No exceptions reported.

blockers.symptom: Only 10 allowlisted accounts (100 for Solutions Partners) can install; others are rejected
blockers.resolution: Switch the project to distribution 'marketplace' (switching a private app later doesn't interrupt existing installs).

blockers.symptom: App installs in developer test accounts but cannot be installed in any other account
blockers.resolution: Have the account owner sign the Acceptable Use Policy on the app's Distribution tab.

blockers.blocker: Installing user lacks permission or portal lacks a required scope
blockers.symptom: Authorization page error; OAuth logs show AUTHORIZATION_REQUEST errors
blockers.resolution: Ask a Super Admin (or user with Marketplace Access) to install; move product-dependent scopes to optionalScopes.

blockers.symptom: Token endpoint returns {"status":"BAD_AUTH_CODE","message":"missing or unknown auth code","error":"invalid_request"}
blockers.resolution: Exchange the code immediately after redirect and make sure redirect_uri matches exactly.

agentCan: Install the CLI, scaffold the project (hs project create), write app-hsmeta.json scopes and redirect URLs, run hs project upload
Create developer test accounts and run test installs via the Distribution tab or the authorize URL
Implement code exchange and 30-minute refresh logic against /oauth/v3/token
Draft listing copy, setup documentation and scope justifications
humanMust: Create the HubSpot developer account and complete the browser step of hs account auth
Recruit 3+ unaffiliated customers with active installs and own the Marketplace submission and review correspondence
Approve Terms of Service, Privacy Policy and pricing published for the listing

uncertainties: Review timelines are HubSpot's stated targets (10 business days initial, ≤60 days after feedback); actual waits are not independently verified.
PKCE support is undocumented; a single community report mentions a 'PKCE required' error — unverified.

Whether refresh tokens rotate on refresh or ever expire is not stated in the current docs; whether the legacy /oauth/v1/token endpoint is deprecated is not stated (it still responded during our probe).
A community report mentions an UNLISTED_APP_OVER_PRIVATE_INSTALL_LIMIT error at 10 installs during migration; not in official docs.
Whether the 'oauth' scope is still required for project-based apps was not verified.
Treatment of HubSpot 'sensitive data' scopes for marketplace apps was not researched.
Developer test account 90-day expiry/renewal rules come from the test-accounts doc via search summary; community answers conflict on renewal after expiry.

sources.title: HubSpot — Manage apps in HubSpot (install limits, AUP, unverified warnings)
HubSpot changelog — New marketplace distribution app install limits
Hands-on probe of HubSpot OAuth endpoints with fake client_id (2026-10-29)

verificationNotes: curl POST https://api.hubapi.com/oauth/v3/token (and /oauth/v1/token) with a fake client_id and code both returned {"status":"BAD_AUTH_CODE","message":"missing or unknown auth code","error":"invalid_request"} — code is checked before client credentials; v1 still responds.
GET https://app.hubspot.com/oauth/authorize with a fake client_id returns HTTP 200 and a JS app shell; the client_id error is rendered client-side, so not observed.

Corrected common belief: 'create a public app in your developer account UI' is outdated — legacy public apps can't be created since 2026-06-23; new OAuth apps are CLI projects (platform 2025.2 launched 2025-09-03, docs now target 2026.03).

Confirmed the install cap precisely: marketplace-distribution OAuth apps 25 accounts before listing (test accounts excluded); private OAuth apps 10 allowlisted accounts (100 for Solutions Partners); static-token apps 1 account.
Did not create a HubSpot account or app (no credentials used).

Verifier confirmed against HubSpot docs (Legacy apps overview, Manage apps, Listing requirements, OAuth quickstart, Test accounts): legacy public apps can't be created as of June 23, 2026; 25 / 10 / 1 install caps excluding test accounts; AUP needed before non-test installs; 3 active unaffiliated installs within 30 days, 10 business days initial review, ≤60 days after feedback; expires_in 1800; test accounts expire after 90 days without API calls.
